text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories. You can simply type an idea, and the AI will produce a picture or a song in seconds. Some people find this exciting, while others feel worried. They believe true creativity comes from human feelings and experiences, not from machines. AI can copy styles and produce new combinations, but it does not understand emotions. Perhaps the best result is when humans and AI work together, using technology to support our own imagination rather than replace it.
